title: DeviceRegistration
description: device -> server, a plain HTTP POST (not a WS message, no type discriminator — same family as notification-event.schema.json) made once, before the device's first WebSocket connection, to register the Keystore key pair it generated at first launch. public_key is the base64-encoded X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo (SPKI) DER bytes of an EC (P-256) public key. Re-registering the same device_id with the same public_key is idempotent; registering a different public_key under an already-registered device_id is rejected (key rotation is not supported yet — a build that needs it registers a new device_id instead).
